name: Shiraha Nadeshiko
source:
A beautiful, mature and neat woman with an older-sister like aura, she seems to like Yuki.
She harbors a big secret, only she and Yuki know of her identity.

[Translated from [url=https://nekocharon.jp/sirene.html]official site[/url]]
